content: Start an AI chat right inside {{sectionName}}. Ask it to find or organize files, summarize documents or draft text, and add any details it needs for your task.

comment.text: Body of the onboarding tour step that highlights the AI chat quick-action tile; used in both the Files and Rooms tours. {{sectionName}} is the translated section name (Files or Rooms), used as a location (inside the section).

usage.context:
// 2. AI chat tile is the last one and may sit past the carousel fold.
 canCreateFiles &&
 elementStep(
 '[data-testid="quick-ai-chat"]',
 t("FilesTour:TourAiAssistantTitle"),
 t("FilesTour:TourAiAssistant", { sectionName: t("Common:Files") }),
 callbacks,
 FILES_TOUR_LABEL,
 6,
 revealQuickActionTile('[data-testid="quick-ai-chat"]'),
 ),

canCreate &&
 showFilter &&
 elementStep(
 '[data-testid="quick-ai-chat"]',
 t("FilesTour:TourAiAssistantTitle"),
 t("FilesTour:TourAiAssistant", { sectionName: t("Common:Rooms") }),
 callbacks,
 ROOMS_TOUR_LABEL,
 6,
 revealQuickActionTile('[data-testid="quick-ai-chat"]'),
 ),
